title: Lifecycle transition combines nodes/ and runs/ writes in one atomic action
context: Alternative approaches: write only the node file; write only the audit file; require two separate calls.
decision: A lifecycle transition writes `nodes/<uuid>.json` (updating the lifecycle field) and appends `runs/<node-uuid>/audit.json` (appending the transition record) in a single atomic action. The CI path-scope gate allows this one exception to the rule that nodes/ and runs/ cannot be touched together.
consequences: Lifecycle state and its audit trail are always consistent; no orphaned audit rows; the exception is documented in the gate as a special case; the write must be atomic or the invariant breaks.
